articles.image_title: LIbanon: TYRE, LEBANON - APRIL 16: The ruins of the Qasmiyeh Bridge are seen after it was completely destroyed by consecutive Israeli airstrikes in southern Lebanon on April 16, 2026. Israeli airstrikes destroyed a key bridge linking southern Lebanon with the rest of the country on Thursday, in the latest attacks targeting infrastructure in the country, Lebanese media reported. The National News Agency said warplanes carried out two consecutive strikes targeting the Qasmiyeh Bridge, the last remaining crossing connecting the Tyre area with the city of Sidon, completely destroying it. The Qasmiyeh Bridge is one of the most strategic crossings in southern Lebanon, linking western, central, and eastern sectors and serving as a key route for people, vehicles, and goods. It had previously sustained damage from Israeli airstrikes before being completely destroyed. Elif Ozturk / Anadolu/ABACAPRESS/ddp images
